claim: Training the Go2 walk on a measured joints fit (fit@0ad6202797c5, a public log's Go2) buys a delay margin in the fitted world and nothing measurable at the easy rung: judged in the fitted world with every action 2 control ticks (40 ms) late, the fit-trained go2-c3-fit tracks 18/40 [0.2926, 0.6151] against the declared-trained go2-c2's 0/40 [0.0, 0.0881] (intervals disjoint); with no delay each policy walks 39/40 [0.8684, 0.9994] in the other's world (38/40 and 40/40 in its own); with kp pinned at 0.8x the fitted world gives 33/40 against 26/40 (overlapping); on the declared constants neither holds 2 ticks (1/40 and 5/40).
argv: rq_mjlab.walk_verdict <run>/model_1499.pt --trials 40 --seed 1000 --device cuda:0 --robot go2 --project projects/go2-walk [--judge-in-fit fit@0ad6202797c5|declared] [--judge-at-scale 0.8 --judge-param kp] [--delay 2] (through the MCP door evaluate_walk)
instrument: mjlab-1.6.0+mujoco-3.13.0+warp-1.17.0+cuda, RTX 3090 Ti, the WSL machine; 40 paired trials per cell (the same seeded draws per trial across cells)

go2-c3-fit chain.attribution_cliffs: kp 0.8x (16/20), kd 2x (17/20), latency 2 ticks (2/20), payload 2 kg (17/20), push 1 m/s (17/20), tilt 8 deg (14/20), joint noise 0.05 rad (17/20), joint friction 0.25 N*m (17/20); survived: friction, armature, joint damping (deploy/go2-c3-fit-deploy/attribution.json)

outcome.repeat: both cross cells at the easy rung were run twice; identical 39/40 each time

caveats: Sim only, and the fit is a public log's Go2 (IIT chirp), not the operator's robot: the fitted world stands in for 'the measured robot'.
The kp rungs pin kp at 0.8x and every other law parameter at x1 (no randomization); the delay rungs keep each world's own law DR. The two rung families are different protocols.

Delay here is the whole action applied late by walk_verdict's Delayed wrapper (control ticks of 20 ms); the gate's attribution applies latency in its own runtime at 20 trials and read go2-c3-fit 2/20 at 2 ticks - a different harness, both stand.
A cross record is never the policy's certificate; judged_at and judged_in_fit name the world.
n=40 per cell: 'no difference' at the easy rung means the intervals overlap, not that the policies are equal.

artifacts.verdicts: docs/artifacts/go2/certificates/ (go2-c2-* and go2-c3-fit-* certificate.json, one per cell); recorded at projects/go2-walk/runs/{go2-c2,go2-c3-fit}/verdict/ (the WSL machine; projects/ is not tracked)
artifacts.studio: the Evaluations page shows every cell as a card (screenshots in projects/go2-walk/.index/screenshots/)

protocol: each policy judged in both worlds (the fitted joints and the declared constants) at delays of 0 and 2 control ticks and at 0.8x kp, 40 paired trials per cell, by walk_verdict; run 2026-09-25 (the maintainers' log, not public)
